rules.statement: A notarial lease is a written contract or agreement within the contemplation of section 7, and the period of limitation for an action for rent due under such a lease is six years.
rules.supporting_quote: "No doubt, also, section 6 was not discussed there at all; but it is inconceivable that if section 6 had any bearing on the question, the eminent Judges who took part in the decision would not have considered it. It seams to me that the whole question of prescription was fully before the Court, and I think the decision is a binding authority in the present case."
